title: Pet-battle trainer arrival starts once after its existing one-second delay
cause: PlayerScriptPetBattle scheduled now+1000 but dispatched while deadline>now. An early update began immediately;an update at/after expiry never began and retained the pending record. The unbound per-player timestamp could also apply an old movement completion to a replacement battle or reset a running battle.

Consume the pending record under RAII lock,release the lock,then require the same live player battle GUID,CREATION status and both PlayerGuid/OwnerGuid membership before the original root/protection/native Begin. Before-logout discards only the pending arrival record. No quest/progression,damage,SQL or battle-engine change.
